BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BE   SEMESTER: V
BRANCH: EEE   SESSION : MO/2019

SUBJECT : EE5201 MICROPROCESSOR & MICROCONTROLLER

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) Explain the importance of timing & control unit. What is the use of W & Z registers? What
happens when RESET pin of μp 8085 is enabled?
[2]
 (b) Draw & explain the Architecture of μp 8085. [3]


Q2 (a) Explain the need of demultiplexing AD7 - AD0 lines. [2]
 (b) Describe the functions of the following registers of μp 8085: Instruction Register, PC, SP,
Incrementer /Decrementer Address latch.
[3]


Q3 (a) Draw and explain the timing diagram needed to execute MVI A, 95H, The opcode of MVI
A is 3EH present is memory at 4563H
[2]
 (b) Connect 8KB RAM to μp8085 system from address C000H. Show address mapping & logic
for chip select & de-multiplexing.
[3]

Q4 (a) Give two examples for each of the following types of instructions and indicate what
each of these instructions do:
i) Instructions with implied addressing.
ii) ALU type of instructions.
[2]
 (b) Two  16  bit  numbers(Hex)  are  saved  in AB01H,AB02H,AB03H,AB04H.Write  an  Assembly
language Program to subtract these numbers and save the result from AB05H. Explain
how processor does the subtraction?
[3]


Q5 (a) Illustrate the steps and draw the timing diagram of data flow when the instruction code
0100 1111(4FH––MOV C,A), stored in location 2005H, is being fetched.
[2]
 (b) What are addressing modes? Specify the ones with suitable examples used for 8085. [3]


Q6 (a) Write the Instruction format of 8085 microprocessor. [2]
 (b) Write an assemble language program to subtract X-Y where X & Y are 3 bytes number
present  in  memory  from  2000H  and  2100H.  Store  the  result  from  2200H.  Use  Direct
Addressing Mode (DAM) Instructions such as LDA, STA.
[3]
